'''HB7''' was an individual who worked for the [[Verga Mer Mining Company]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point after an incident on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], HB7 sent an internal memo to all Verga Mer area managers, discussing problems on Tilnes that had been caused by the activities of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] and the [[Thaereian military]].
